name: prompt-master
description: Polishes your rough prompt before Claude reads it: asks what's missing, then rewrites it clearly, adding nothing you didn't say. One-click on/off button above the prompt box. To choose which model writes the suggested prompt (Opus by default), go to this plugin's Settings.

model.title: Prompt Master model
model.description: Which Claude model reads your prompt and writes the suggested one

maxQuestions.title: Most questions per prompt
maxQuestions.description: How many questions it may ask before it writes the suggested prompt

review.title: Review before sending
review.description: Show the polished prompt in a dialog before it is sent: send it, try another version, send your original, or type what to change
